retained_failures: The initial near-integer corpus failed draw 5 because the native incoming-transform shortcut replaces requested nearest sampling with default bilinear sampling.
Fixed fixture 8 and the one-pixel covered clearing-sprite regression failed before reproducing native near-scale sprite eligibility. The latter wrote red 1 instead of native red 0.

The first two canvas integration attempts did not execute tests: another session's untracked LibJS regex compiler/VM files had transient sort and method-name errors. Those files were not changed by this task; the third attempt passed after their correction.
limitations: Counts include no-ops and explicit declines, including unsupported matrices and mappings.
The raw near-integer shortcut conservatively declines rounding-induced layer crops pending the full desired-output analysis.
The raw shortcut retains unpremultiplied sRGB storage before a real blur; color effects resolve through native default bilinear sampling instead.
Scaled shadow foregrounds, further spatial chains, rotations, SVG graphs, boolean shadows, large sigma, tiling and native browser bridges remain.
Full canonical Linux typechecking used available Skia development files and does not prove Skia-free browser compilation, linking or execution.
